Chapter 6819: Thunder Marsh

Chapter 6819: Thunder Marsh

“Don’t choose the hard way foolishly.” Bat Ancestor used his sound waves again.

Six-foot and Ironleaf immediately blocked them.

“Traitors, prepare to die!” Six-foot shouted. He had a more fiery temperament compared to his peers, leaping into space for a kick.

It swept away the clouds and fog from the sky. The force alone shook Frenzy City violently, capable of sending it flying for a million miles.

“You dare?!” Bat retaliated with a mighty sound wave against the incoming foot.

The impact forced Six-foot several steps backward. After all, Bat was still stronger.

“I will end Frenzy today!” Ironleaf joined the fray. Leaves grew from his body and blossomed into crimson flowers.

They flew out and turned into swords, soaring straight for Bat.

“Bring it.” Bat shouted and adorned a weapon resembling a dragon’s claw - Nightmare. A colossal black hand descended against Golden Lamp to everyone’s horror.

“You’re not leaving here alive, Bat!” Blaze summoned a gourd to unleash a solar flame in the shape of a dragon. It surged upward while being the size of a mountain range. Suns appeared around it.

“Bam!” It raised its claws to fight against the dark one.

“That’s right!” Six-foot stomped again. His foot seemed to be larger than Golden Lamp, pressing down against Frenzy City. Cracks appeared in space.

“Start!” Bat ordered his men to attack Golden Lamp, hoping to alleviate the pressure.

“Rumble!” The gate opened and demons poured out, roaring in a frenzy.

They numbered in the millions and included all types of demons - serpents, tigers, fiery lions, and eagles...

Heavenly eagles comprised the main fighting force of Frenzy. Their progenitor’s bloodline made them stronger.

Some were as large as mountains, creating tornadoes with each flap. Others were tiny like regular eagles. However, they were golden and impervious to weapons. Their claws could tear anything apart.

“Thunder Marsh!” Thunder Emperor activated her kingdom’s grand formation.

Her imperial aura erupted, fueling the runic arrays made from lightning. They gathered together to form a boundless marsh.

“To battle!” The iron trees grew at a rapid rate and melted into molten iron, attempting to burn all the eagles.

“Kill them all!” The big foots harnessed the power of the grand veins beneath. Golden light surged from below and made them gigantic. They gained an armor of light, allowing them to swing their picks at the demons.

“Ahh!” The seemingly unstoppable horde of demons suffered heavy casualties.

Their corpses and blood turned into hills and rivers all over Golden Lamp. The defenders displayed immaculate heroism and teamwork, not yielding an inch.

Originally, Bat wanted to use the horde to disrupt the defenses. After buying enough time, he would try to destroy Thunder Kingdom and seize the shrine.

Alas, the defenders came prepared. Each team selected the right target to neutralize.
